balls.text: worked off the toes for two more, out of the blockhole. What a finish for Kings! It's given them a fighting chance
lovely bowling but another four! An inadvertent Natmeg, through his legs, and away through fine leg
clattered into the stands again! A slower ball from Boult, sits up outside off stump, and MSK slams up into his launch over midwicket!
dropped at short backward square! Oh my, Chahal this time with the butterfingers, RR have been abysmal at the death in recent times. That was full into the toes and should have been swallowed

shuffles across the crease, Boult fires it down the leg side and gets away with the wide... MSK reviews the non-given wide. It's all deeply subjective really. He was set up outside off when the ball was released, so all's fair
low full toss, muscled out through deep midwicket! Misses his blockhole by a whisker and pays the price!

dropped, and goes for four! Too full from Chahal, on the toes, Curran connects well but picks out Ferreira behind square. But he over-runs the chance as the spin curls it back at where he was running from, and bursts through his fingers into the rope!
humungous! A dismissive slap across the length delivery, kneeling down the track to give it the full "will you marry me?" Yes, yes, yes is the answer! Cloud nine over wide long-on!
sits back in the crease, and muscled hard down the ground! Curran gets right underneath his launch, and this over is getting messy now!
big wind-up again, beats the bat, thumps the pad. Curran calls him through for the single
looped up, wide of off stump, but too wide...
swivels into the flat pull over midwicket! Played on length, with oodles of muscle and long levers. Walloped!
back of a length, and hoisted into the gap at midwicket! A lusty swing, sufficient contact, the game is afoot!
another yorker, tailing in on leg, that's an excellent finish, dug out to the leg side, but he gets out of his spell well
on the back foot, tapped to the on-side, another single
gives himself room on the full length from round the wicket, but punched back to the bowler, in his followthrough

another cheeky ramp! Curran has played that well tonight, another short ball from Saini from round the wicket, angling in on the left-hander, who lifts it off the face of the bat, with extra wristwork to lift it over the keeper
right up to the toes, a well-directed yorker, chopped out to the on-side
cracked out to deep square, loses his shape on the big wind-up. Again
back of a length, but again Curran can't get any timing into his stroke. A hard hack out to deep midwicket. Zampa's work is done
slapped into the off side
Under-edged on the massive mow across the line, and you can't set a field for that! Flies away fine through the finest of legs. Rare boundary!
pushed out wide, a mistimed slap bobbles out into the covers. Just another single... this isn't igniting just yet for Kings...
tossed up, Curran comes forward, bat and pad together to blot away the googly
swiped back over the bowler's head, not timed but tidied up at long-off
another wild swipe but clothed to mid-off. Sharma is done, a mixed spell, but he ended it well
huge wind-up, nearly swings himself off his feet with a massive yahoo to leg. But the slower ball confounds him as it sneaks just past off stump
dipping on the yorker length, clipped with solid timing off the toes, to midwicket
slower ball, tight line on a full length, worked to the on-side
wide full toss, thrashed hard at deep cover, but he missed out there. Could have put it anywhere
ramped! Superbly done Short, leaping off the deck, Curran rocks back with an open face and dinks it over the keeper!
extra over-spin as this one leaps at the splice, and MSK dots down into the pitch
worked into the on-side but can't get the single away
tidy lines from Chahal, another dot to ramp up Shahrukh's nerves
full length, and clipped to the on-side
clipped off the legs to the on-side
tossed up on middle and off, worked to long-on for the single
pushed onto the back foot, and tapped into the covers. Another over ticks by, with Saini's figures looking rather rosier now

slower ball, straight up in the air! Oh no, that's curtains for Jitesh. A tricky catch, tracking back in the covers from the sub fielder Ferreira, but well judged to dent Kings' hopes of that grandstand finish
short, swung into the gap at cow corner! Jitesh is on the move now! Another firm hoist, into the gap on the leg side. Game on now!
that's a better strike! Opens his stance, launches with intent up into the wide line, gets a proper piece of that one, high over long-off!
Skews off the open face, and beats the fielder at deep cover! An energetic thrash off the full length, Hetmyer was in two minds, whether to go for the catch or cover the spin. He did neither!
angled bat on the back foot, worked down to deep third
steps to the pitch, outside off, and clipped to the on-side. A few wides, but just singles all told
targetting the wide yorker with the outswinger, thumped off the back foot to long-off
very full, tailing in at the blockhole, open face on the drive into the covers
lifting off the deck as Curran raises his gloves high to elude the ball
back of a length, wide line, Jitesh swings into a back-foot cut, bobbles down to deep third
cracked through the line to mid-off
wide of off stump, overcooked that one
low full-toss, swinging away, cracked hard back at the bowler, who pounces brilliantly in his followthrough
thumped back down the track, can't get that one away
can't cut that one off! Pushed out wide, not a bad ball but Jitesh responded well with a riotous spank in front of the cover sweeper. Top shot
back of a length, crashed hard out to deep cover where Hetmyer does brilliantly to intercept a fast-travelling stroke. A sprint and a well-timed dive
firm blade presented back down the line, mid-on gathers
a gallop to the pitch and slapped to the on-side
up on the toes, and chopped back to the bowler
swished off the back foot to deep point. A mix-and-match over there. This innings is an odd mash-up of frenetic scoring and stodgy singles
up on the toes, cracked off the back foot to mid-off for another single
drawn out of his crease, and loses his shape in the big wind-up, under-edged to backward square
rocks back to cut the legbreak, but no power on the stroke as cover gathers
tapped to the on-side, on the front foot
outside off, and crashed past deep cover!  Width is the key for Curran, and he seizes on the chance to free his arms and get his innings going
spanked into the stands again! Plants the front foot to meet the full length, swings lustily for the Himalayas, clean over long-off once more!
bouncer, well disguised as Jitesh ducks in a hurry, not a lot of pace on it, but gunning for his lughole all the same
slower ball, on the pads, nudged out to square leg for the single
presses the single to rotate the strike
huge blow! Looked for a moment he got too far underneath it, as he gave himself room and opened up the covers, but the bat speed was ample at this altitude! High over long-off!
on the back foot, tucked out to midwicket for another single
flipped off the back foot, out to deep midwicket. A fine first over from Chahal, just three runs from it, and Kings have called for a much-needed Time Out.
half forward, on the front foot, pressed back down the pitch as the slow death continues...
pressed on the front foot into the covers
overspin on that one as Jitesh leans through a slog-sweep and can't connect. The ball hops over the bails into the keeper's gloves
good areas from Chahal, dipping on middle and leg and turning as Jitesh leans forward
tossed up, pushed back down the pitch into the off side
on the back foot, chopped to the off side. It's drip-drip progress for now
thrashed off the back foot, out to deep cover. Singles are all that Kings can muster for now. Still, 59 is a target...
tossed up, dipping on middle and off, and dabbed to the on-side
leaning onto the front foot, tapped to the on-side
on the back foot, clawed out to deep midwicket for another single
over the wicket, pressed off the back foot into the off side
shapes in on a full length and thumps the back leg, but sliding down the leg side. Another over of solid control for RR
clipped into the leg side
bouncer, sliding down the leg side. We'll have that one again
onto the front foot, solid punch into the covers

swings for the hills, stumps splattered! And a chastising exit for Livingstone, after his recent heroics. Never at the races tonight, and lost patience with that attempted launch across the line. Kings in a hole now
attempted ramp, Saini follows him outside off stump and Livingstone wears it right on the knee-cap. Ouch
back of a length, swings into the pull, a touch toe-ended down to long-on
down the pitch from Livingstone, but he can't get to the pitch as Zampa reacts. A single to long-on, and another tidy over to complete the powerplay for RR
tossed up outside off, delicate turn on the googly, blocked to the off side
full length on the pads, nudged to the on-side
pinned on the shin and that's plumb! Dhawan kneels into the sweep but he's beaten on length as the ball pitches in line and thumps him in front of middle. No thought of a review. Huge wicket!
down the pitch, meeting the leg-stump line and worked to long-on
tossed up, angled bat on the front foot, pushed to point
back of a length, Livingstone swishes across the line again but can't get hold of the subtle change of length. That's a superb over to put RR back on top in a tit-for-tat powerplay
short, and drags his head inside the line of the bouncer. Well directed change-up from Boult
back-cut, can't beat point as Boult gets his reward for a tight line across the right-hander. A fine over building
soft hands on the back foot, opening the face to tap the off-stump line to point
on the back foot, open-faced glide down through backward point
tight line, full length, solid block back down the pitch
sliding past the legs, reload
hacked off a good length! One sighter will suffice for Livi! A hard-handed swing across the line, under-edged on impact but it mattered not, the bat-speed did the business through midwicket
full toss, tapped back to the bowler in his followthrough as Livingstone takes the sighter

too easy at midwicket! A soft dismissal, but Taide's beans were pumping. Back of a length, and spannered to Padikkal on the edge of the circle, high on the bat so little power through the pull. A timely wicket for RR after a rowdy few overs
very full length, wide line and beats an open-faced whack. Well bowled
tailing into the toes, and flicked magnificently off the toes! Real intent now from Kings, through backward square for another four, and Saini is under the cosh
clubbed back whence it came! Angles in from round the wicket, so a solid lump through the line, billiard-ball rebound off the bat through long-on!
another gallop down the track, punched with an open face but straight to cover. Boult ties up his over well to restore some decorum for RR
good response from Boult, tight line, shaping away, solid block on the front foot
fizzed off the back foot, and up and over the covers, watching the ball right into the middle of a very aggressive blade. He's in the mood
on the back foot, opens the face for a chop down to deep third. No swing in sight all of a sudden for Boult
whisked off the pads! That's clean and magnificent, high behind square as Boult tails the full length into the toes and pays the price!
dances down the pitch so Boult drags his length back, Dhawan responds with a firm clip off the hips, gathered well at fine leg
clawed across the line! Sits up just enough for Atharva to swipe himself off the mark through midwicket, and complete a leaky over for Sandeep. 16 coming from it
on a good length, leans into the drive to mid-off
slower ball, back of a length, soft hands and pushed to the off side, with Samson now up to the stumps to keep Dhawan honest
skip and wallop! Dhawan's in the mood now! A premeditated skitter to the pitch, putting his foot down with Sharma already bleeding in this over, and deposited high over the sightscreen!
shading away on a full length, Dhawan leaves alone on the angle
Free hit. Lumped over long on! Full length, comfortable bend into the pads and walloped over mid-on. A costly start to this over!
tight line from over the wicket, shaping away on off stump and fenced with an open face out to point. But he's overstepped...

poked in the air again, and nearly a second return catch! This was travelled faster and flatter, and was past Boult before he could adjust. That late away movement on a full length causing bother from the outset
walks across his stumps for a nurdle to leg. Boult is momentarily interested in the lbw, but didn't do quite enough as the deflection flies into the leg side
right up to that full length, late swing away, and driven with the angle into the covers, gathered with a tumble
outside off, shaping away and no stroke offered

poked back to the bowler! Boult leaps to his right in his followthrough, closes his fingers around a popped chance, in the air for an eternity. A full-length inswinger, stopping on the batter and Prabhsimran's hard hands do the rest. A huge scalp in his first over, yet again, for Boult!
balls.dismissal: P Simran Singh — caught and bowled

balls.text: full length outside off, not a lot of swing as Singh punches with firm forearms through the covers to open his account
Charges down and seals the win for Royals, does Jurel! Sees the tossed up ball and doesn't miss out on the chance. Goes straight back over the bowler's head to end the game.
Fuller on the pads, whipped away through midwicket.
Fuller on the stumps, he smacks it on the bounce to long-off.
Quicker and on a length on middle and leg, worked away through square leg for a couple. The throw is flat and on the stumps, but Jurel is in with a dive.
Length ball around leg, heaved to deep midwicket. They don't take the run.

Shikhar Dhawan has pulled off a stunner, or has he? He dives forward to catch that and then slaps his thigh in celebration. The umpires would want to have another look. Curran bowls it outside off, Hetmyer slaps it aerially towards cover, where Dhawan has his fingers under the ball.
Length ball outside off, Hetmyer stands tall and punches it well over covers for a one-bounce four. It was at 112.1 kph. Middling it all.
Slower one on a length, angling away, he punches it to cover.
Another slower one outside off, this time he finds sweeper cover with the hack.
Clubbed through covers! Back of the hand slower one at 111.6 kph, full outside off. Hetmyer gives it his all to smack it through the off side.
Rabada has the last laugh. Nails the yorker on middle and leg, he looks to whip it away but gets a leading edge to backward point. Taide makes no mistake and Parag walks back dejected.
Slower one full and outside off, Parag doesn't pick it and gets it off the toe end back towards the bowler.
Bowls it into the surface on a length outside off, another swing and a miss.
Banged short and wide, he thinks of pulling that before letting it pass over his head.
Back of a length outside off, he looks to heave it across again but misses.
Back-to-back sixes for Parag and Royals come alive! Fullish on off and middle, he whips it over deep midwicket for another biggie.
Parag deposits it high and long over deep midwicket. Rabada bowls it on a length outside off, he fetches it from outside off an crossbats it over the on side.
Full and angled down leg, he misses the flick. What's more, the hooter goes off! He has overstepped.
Fuller outside off, it is the slower one. Hettie only mistimes it back to the bowler. Hetmyer lauds the bowler but Curran has something to say back.

Curran bounces Hetmyer out! But Hetmyer reviews immediately. He digs it in and asks the batter to pull again. He goes for it but it gets big on him. There was a definite sound as the ball passed bat in real time. The ump raises his finger immediately as a result. But there is a flat line on Snicko and Hettie stays!
Length ball on leg at 129.8 kph, Parag mistimes it towards deep midwicket.
Hetmyer dropped by Harpreet running back! Short ball, he looks to pull it over square leg but only skies it high. Brar runs back from the circle but fails to hang on.
Length ball outside off, he looks to go over covers but gets beaten.
Rocketed away through covers! Bowled full and outside off, turns into an overpitched one. Hetmyer middles it through covers.
Charges down and Arshdeep bangs it short. He looks to flatbat it but gets beaten.

Rabada gets a hand to it but fails to prevent the boundary! Goes for the yorker angling away but dishes out a full toss at 136.2 kph. Parag looks to go big and gets a thick outside edge towards short third, who dives but parries it away.
Low full toss well outside off, only manages to hit it to sweeper cover.
In the air.... lands in between three fielders! Full and wide again, Hetmyer skies it high and it lands between midwicket running back, long-off running to his right and sweeper cover to his left.
Full and outside off, just inside the tramline. He gets across and looks to heave over the on side but misses.
Full and outside off, Hetmyer looks to drive but is beaten. Looks at the umpire for the signal that never comes.
Starts with a wide length ball, Hettie lets that be.
Fuller outside off, slices it through backward point to keep strike.
Works the length ball around off through wide mid-on.
Gets a full ball outside off, he slice-drives it past backward point for a couple.

A difficult shot to play and get out! Ellis gets Jaiswal. It is s low full toss on middle and off, he looks to play the switch-hit over the off side. Gets it off the middle of the bat to Rishi Dhawan at backward point. Either side of that fielder or above him it would have been four.
Seeing Jaiswal back away, he sprays it full and wide outside off, passes outside the tramline and called wide.
Full and angling away, he slaps it wide of long-off but gets just one.
Length ball pitching outside leg, he works it through midwicket to get to yet another half-century, off 35 balls.

Streaky! Unlucky Curran! It is the back-of-the-hand slower one on a length around off and middle at 113.6 kph. Hetmyer looks to hit it across the line but gets a thick inside edge. Beats short fine leg, who dives but does not get a hand to it.
Sprays it well wide of off, he leaves it alone.
Full toss on the pads, flicked to fine leg.

Finds the gap perfectly! Jaiswal is early in getting across the line and standing outside off stump. Curran bowls it full in line of off and middle, and so it ends up on his pads. He whips it over midwicket and gets four.
Very full outside off, squeezed out to backward point.
Slower length ball outside off, he punches it wide of long-off.
Full and angling down, he gets inside the line but misses the flick.
Hammered! Gets across early to explore the on side. Curran bowls it full outside the sixth-stump line. Hetmyer takes toll and hits it back over the non-striker.
Cleverly played! Gets across the line to play the scoop. Ellis bowls it on a length and angles it away. Jaiswal adjusts and scoops it over the wicketkeeper.
Fuller around off, it is the slower one again at 109.2 kph. Hetmyer slices it aerially but is well out of reach of Rabada running in to his right from long-off.
Slower short ball going away, he is well early into his attempted pull and misses.
Full length ball going away from off, he slaps it towards cover, where Shikhar Dhawan dives and half-stops it.
Angles it away he hits it aerially to sweeper cover.
Powered away and Rabada at long-off can only watch it sail over. Full outside off, it is the slower one. Hetmyer picks it early and deposits right over the long-off fielder.

Oh my word! What a shot that is. Full credit to the bowler, first up, for nailing the yorker outside leg, seeing the batter back away. But Jaiswal also gets his bat down quickly to slice it through point. Sweeper gets to his right but is far from the ball despite the dive.
Fuller around off, gets it off the leading edge through covers.
Goes straight and long! Full and in line of the stumps, Hetmyer smacks it right back over the non-striker. Long-on wasn't even in the frame.
Bangs it short, it is a sharp bouncer. Thinks of pulling before ducking under it. Wide called.
Length ball outside off, he mistomes the heave across and gets it next to the pitch on the on side.
Back of a length around off, he sways back to let it pass.
Length ball well outside off, looks to drive away from his body but gets beaten on the outside.
Quicker on middle and leg, he goes back to flick it through backward square leg.

Catching practice to deep square leg! Nicely tossed up, full on the pads. Samson gets his front foot down and looks to heave this nicely over deep square leg. Flicks this right down Rishi Dhawan, the sub's throat in the deep. Chahar fold his hands in celebration.
Fuller on the stumps, punched through midwicket.
Floated up around middle and leg, it is the googly. Jaiswal gets down for the switch hit but misses.
Shortish around leg, he charges down and slaps it through covers for two.
Fuller and quicker around off, goes back and punches it through cover-point.
Almost hit straight to long leg! Banged in short on the body, he thinks of ducking while getting his bat to pull. Aerially hit towards Rishi Dhawan, the sub.

Taken on the second attempt by Harpreet! Two turbanators get into the act and that's all from the DDP show tonight. Arshdeep bowls it on a length outside off at 118.4 kph. He goes back and looks to slice it between short third and backward point. The lack of pace means he ends up ending it towards backward point, where Harpreet jumps, gets two hands to it but it pops out, yet manages to hold on on the second go.
Very full in line of the stumps, hammers it back past the non-striker. Curran slides at long-on and keeps it down to two. 29-ball fifty for Padikkal!
That is as clean as any of the shots played so far. Walks back and across off. Gets a length ball outside off at 134.1 kph. Swings his bat across the line to deposit it 83 metres over deep midwicket.
Full and outside off, he looks to get across for the sweep but is beaten by the pace. 142.3 kph was the speed. Rolls off his pads towards square leg.
Bowls it on a length just outside off, he stays back and looks to cut but misses.
Fuller in line off the stumps, he looks to reverse hit but gets it off his gloves, the off his pads and then towards short third.
Spinning in to him quickly at a length, he goes back and heaves it to deep midwicket.
Quicker and on a length on the stumps at 88.3 kph. He goes back and nudges it through midwicket.
Wrong'un on a length, he goes back and pulls it through square leg for a couple.
Turns it in, he goes back and heaves it away to long-on.

What a shot! Excellent use of the crease from Jaiswal. Bowls it on a length, he backs away, gets the desired width as a result. The ball bounces it at an ideal length for him to slap it over the off side. Lands full on the boundary cushions wide of long-off running to his right. They are checking it if it indeed landed on the full or bounced just before. Given as four.
Slower one outside off, cuts in after landing. He waits for a bit before keeping it out towards backward point.
Short ball angling away around off, he pulls it through midwicket, all along the ground.
Length ball angling away outside off, he charges down to slash but gets beaten due to the bounce.
Full and on the pads, flicked away through midwicket.
Fuller around off, driven to cover.
Crunched! Dances down the track and nails the drive through covers. It was a length ball but he converted it to a full one by using his feet.
Shortish around middle, goes back through midwicket.
Fuller and spinning in on his pads, flicks it through midwicket.
Fuller, it is the googly around leg and middle at 84.7 kph. He flicks it through midwicket.
Quicker legspin, a hint of turn towards off. He goes back and steers it to short third. Bowled at 91.7 kph.
Fuller and angling away, slower through the air, goes onto the back foot and punches it through wide mid-off.
Quicker through the air and fuller around off and middle, half a lunge and he blocks that.
Fuller around off and middle, defensively pushed towards cover-point. Royals end the powerplay on 57 for 1.
Back of a length ball leaving him, he has a go at that but is beaten.
Thumped over covers! Banged in short, he backs away while taking a step down. Slashes it well over covers
Excellent contact! Backs away just as the bowler releases the ball. It is full and angling away. Slices it well over deep backward point, deep third running to his left is a spectator.
Full on middle, squeezes it towards backward point, where Chahar lets it through. Too many misfields from Kings already.
Length ball around middle and leg, gets an inside edge onto his back leg as he looks to heave this away.
Full outside off, beats cover with the drive. Dhawan chases it down from mid-off, slides and fumbles a touch. Allows the batters to eke out a third.
Length ball around off and middle, pats it towards point for a quick one.
Guides the length ball to short third.
Angles this one away on a length, he misses the cut.
Slashed away hard and beats sweeper cover to his right. Full and angling away. It is bowled at 126.3 kph. He leans into it and slaps it through the off side.
Fuller on middle and leg, driven right back. He gets the hand to that. It was the back-of-the-hand slower one.
BAck of a length around leg and middle, he hops and opens the face of the bat to place it to deep third.
Length ball, climbs up a bit more, he steers it to deep third.
Angles it away on a length, guides it wide of backward point.
Oh that sails over! Didn't think he had gotten enough. Fullish on the stumps, he looks to whip it away to the on side but gets a leading edge. It sails 63 metres over wide third.
Angling away on a length, he looks to go over the off side but gets a thickish outside edge to deep third.
Angles it away on a length, he glides it wide of slip to deep third.
Fuller around off, gets it off the inner half towards square leg for one.
Poor ball. Strays on the pads with the length ball, he just tucks it fine to beat the fielder at fine leg.
Fuller outside off, driven through covers for one.
Banged in short, he goes for the pull but misses. Wide given.
Beats deep backward point to his right! Shortish and just outside off. Jaiswal stands tall and punch-cuts it through the off side. Such is his timing that the fielder in the deep had no chance.
Fuller and outside off, he gets his front foot forward and lifts his arms.
Fuller on middle and leg, drives it on the up towards mid-on.
Length ball around off and middle, looks to defend. Gets an inside edge onto the back pad.
A misfield from Arshdeep now! Padikkal gets going with a four. He angles it away on a length, punches it through backward point. Deep third gets around but concedes four.

Pinned in front! No second though from the umpire and he raises the dreaded finger immediately. Spears it on a length outside off, angling in on off and middle. Buttler's feet are cemented as he stands on off to flick it, almost falls over. Misses the ball and is hit right on the pads. Rabada and the Kings are ecstatic. A hat-trick of ducks in IPL 2023 for Buttler.
Bowls it on a length again, moves away a touch past Buttler's poking blade. Beaten.
Beauts. Angles it in on a length around off, nips it away ever so slightly. Buttler pokes at it but is beaten.
Begins with a length ball outside off, Buttler pushes it towards short cover.
Almost a return catch! Fuller on middle and leg, looks to turn it across but gets it off the face towards the bowler as it turns in his hand. Just short of Curran's right hand.
Jaiswal in his mode! Length ball, goes back and heaves it well over midwicket.

Much authoritative this time. But a better fielding effort would have helped the bowler. Short and outside off, he cuts it through point. Arshdeep is wide at deep third, runs to his left, dives but does so over the ball.
Inside edge to get going! Bowls it on a length outside off, he looks to slap it through the off side. Gets a thick inside edge past the wicketkeeper
Fuller outside off, driven to mid-off of the front foot.
Bowls it on a length outside off, not much lateral movement there. He covers the stumps and shoulders arms.
